description: Stuff by Rambo commerce page security headers (SEC-002). Apex and www only; /gesture-flow, /license, /legal and descendants.

rules.expression: (http.host in {"stuffbyrambo.com" "www.stuffbyrambo.com"}) and (lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/gesture-flow" "/license" "/legal"} or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/gesture-flow/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/license/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/legal/"))

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://licenses.stuffbyrambo.com; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

Permissions-Policy.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), display-capture=()
